item.description_tr:
🌟 Colors sent randomly. 🌟
The headphones that will transform your everyday life have arrived! Perfect for working out at the gym, enjoying some music in traffic, taking online classes, or simply relaxing with your favorite playlists! 🎧💥
📌 Product parameters:
Lightweight and compact: Only 5-6g per earphone. Perfect to take anywhere! 🏃‍♂️💨
High-performance battery:
🔋 5-7 hours of continuous use
⏳ 480 hours in standby (more than 20 days!)
⚡ Fast recharge: 1-1.5 hours in the case.
210mAh case: Charges your earbuds multiple times without needing a wall outlet! 🔄
Range up to 12m: Listen to music even with your phone on the other end of the house! 🏠🎶
Compatible with all phones: Android, iOS, Windows, and any device with Bluetooth! 📱💻✔️
🎯 FUNCTIONS AND HIGHLIGHTS:
Smart táctil control: Touch to play/pause, skip songs, activate voice assistant, and answer calls! 👆🎶
Use individually or in pairs: Use one earphone or both together, as you prefer! 🔄🎧
Hi-Fi sound with Basso 8D: total immersion in music! 🎶🔥
Bluetooth 5.0: Stable and lag-free connection – perfect for videos and calls! 📞🟦
Auto On/Off: Did you open the box? Connect now! Is it closed? It shuts off automatically! 🤖🔌
Notices in English: Grab attention with clear and modern prompts! 🗣️🔊
Virtual GPS: Never lose your headphones again! 🗺️📍
📦 WHAT'S IN THE BOX:
1 pair of Bluetooth headphones
1x Charging case
1x USB cable
1x User Manual (in Portuguese!) 📖)

💬 Perfect for:
For those who love practicality.
Want quality without paying a lot?
You need headphones for everyday use. 🎧❤️
No more wires! No more complications!
Secure your I13 now and transform your audio experience! 🛒🎶
